general.title: Group and timebox your work in Cycles.
general.description: Break work down by timeboxed chunks, work backwards from your project deadline to set dates, and make tangible progress as a team.

comic.title: Cycles are repetitive time-boxes.
comic.description: A sprint, an iteration, and or any other term you use for weekly or fortnightly tracking of work is a cycle.

active.title: No active cycle
active.description: An active cycle includes any period that encompasses today's date within its range. Find the progress and details of the active cycle here.

general.title: Save filtered views for your project. Create as many as you need
general.description: Views are a set of saved filters that you use frequently or want easy access to. All your colleagues in a project can see everyone's views and choose whichever suits their needs best.

comic.title: Views work atop Work item properties.
comic.description: You can create a view from here with as many properties as filters as you see fit.

no_issues.title: Create a work item and assign it to someone, even yourself
no_issues.description: Think of work items as jobs, tasks, work, or JTBD. Which we like. A work item and its sub-work items are usually time-based actionables assigned to members of your team. Your team creates, assigns, and completes work items to move your project towards its goal.

comic.title: Work items are building blocks in pbot.
comic.description: Redesign the pbot UI, Rebrand the company, or Launch the new fuel injection system are examples of work items that likely have sub-work items.

general.title: Map your project milestones to Modules and track aggregated work easily.
general.description: A group of work items that belong to a logical, hierarchical parent form a module. Think of them as a way to track work by project milestones. They have their own periods and deadlines as well as analytics to help you see how close or far you are from a milestone.

comic.title: Modules help group work by hierarchy.
comic.description: A cart module, a chassis module, and a warehouse module are all good example of this grouping.

general.title: Write a note, a doc, or a full knowledge base. Get Galileo, pbot's AI assistant, to help you get started
general.description: Pages are thoughts potting space in pbot. Take down meeting notes, format them easily, embed work items, lay them out using a library of components, and keep them all in your project's context. To make short work of any doc, invoke Galileo, pbot's AI, with a shortcut or the click of a button.

execution.title: Batch
execution.load_failed: The batch could not be loaded.
execution.not_found: This batch does not exist or has been deleted.
execution.completed_hint: This batch is completed and its record is frozen. A re-run opens a new batch.

markdown.hint: Markdown is stored and shown as typed: bold, inline code, lists, links and images all work.

step.title: Step {number}
step.verdict_hint: A verdict is written once and cannot be changed — a wrong one is corrected in a new batch.
step.verdict_pass_locked: This step is marked ✔. The verdict is final.
step.verdict_fail_locked: This step is marked ✘. The verdict is final.
step.verdict_frozen: This batch is completed — no verdict can be written any more.
step.confirm_verdict_pass: The step will be recorded as ✔ (pass). A verdict cannot be changed afterwards; a wrong one is corrected by running the case again in a new batch.
step.confirm_verdict_fail: The step will be recorded as ✘ (fail). A verdict cannot be changed afterwards; a wrong one is corrected by running the case again in a new batch.
step.actual_placeholder: What you saw, verbatim — the screen text, the value, the message.
step.fail_needs_measurement: A ✘ step needs a measured value: write what you saw, or attach a screenshot.
step.save_failed: The measured value could not be saved.
step.verdict_failed: The verdict could not be written.

case.steps_hint: Tick each step as you execute it.
case.conclusion_hint: Choose one of the four states, then press “Conclude”. A conclusion is written once.
case.conclusion_locked: The conclusion was written and is final.
case.conclusion_frozen: This batch is completed — no conclusion can be written any more.
case.confirm_conclusion_content: The case will be recorded as “{conclusion}”. A conclusion cannot be changed afterwards; a wrong one is corrected by running the case again in a new batch.
case.evidence_placeholder: Paths, screenshots, pasted logs or command output.
case.remove_confirm_content: The case record and its step records are removed from this batch. The case itself is not deleted and its number stays.
